<b>Advanced Alchemy</b> is a [[Gather Wishes|Gather Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. It can be started by talking to [[Alchemist Zylotol]] in the [[Wormways]] after it becomes overrun with Plasmium in [[Act 3]], and after <i>[[Alchemist's Assistant]]</i> wish is completed.

== Wish ==
[[File:Plasmified Blood.png|link=Plasmified Blood|left|thumb|100x100px]]

Alchemist Zylotol asks [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] to extract 10 samples of [[Plasmified Blood]] and deliver them to him. He gives her the [[Needle Phial]] once more, which Hornet must charge and stab into [[Lifeblood#Mutation|plasmified]] enemies, such as [[Plasmid]]s, [[Plasmidas]]es, or [[Plasmified Zango]], to extract their blood.

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Alchemist Zylotol 01.png!Location of Alchemist Zylotol in the Wormways
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Plasmium Gland.png|link=Plasmium Gland|left|thumb|100x100px]]

After delivering the Plasmified Blood to Alchemist Zylotol, he rewards Hornet with the [[Plasmium Gland]], allowing her to limitlessly recharge the [[Plasmium Phial]] at a bench.
